name: 矮脚爬爬
evolution: 矮脚爬爬 → 恶魔红钻 Lv.36
description: 足较短，翻倒后很难再顺利站起来。野外发现的矮脚爬爬里面十个有八个正在努力翻身。因为可爱的外表而受到许多小洛克的喜爱，但受惊时会咬人，致使王国只能贴出告示，警告大家不要轻易触碰。
descriptionEn: Its legs are rather short, so once it topples over it has a hard time getting back up. Eight out of ten Aijiaopapa found in the wild are struggling to turn themselves over. Its cute appearance makes it a favorite of many young Lokes, but it bites when startled, so the kingdom had to post notices warning everyone not to touch it carelessly.

skills.name: 蝙蝠
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage and drains 100% as HP.

skills.name: 锐利眼神
skills.descriptionEn: The enemy gains Physical DEF and Magic DEF -120%.

skills.name: 飞断
skills.description: 造成物伤，己方队伍获得1次奉献：威力+20。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; your team gains 1 Dedication: power +20.

skills.name: 尾后针
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy spirit.

skills.name: 网缚
skills.description: 造成物伤，敌方获得物防-30%。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; the enemy gains Physical DEF -30%.

skills.name: 力量吞噬
skills.description: 敌方获得全技能威力-20，自己获得全技能威力+20。
skills.descriptionEn: The enemy gains all-skill power -20; self gains all-skill power +20.

skills.name: 极限撕裂
skills.description: 造成物伤，若自己生命高于50%，使用后自己获得双攻-50%。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; if self HP is above 50%, self gains both ATK stats -50% after use.

skills.name: 以重制重
skills.description: 造成物伤，敌方体重越高，本次技能威力越高。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; the heavier the enemy, the higher this skill’s power.

skills.name: 草虫冲击
skills.description: 造成物伤，若敌方本回合更换精灵，本次威力+50且无视敌方系别抵抗。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; if the enemy switches spirits this turn, power +50 and ignores the enemy’s type resistance.

skills.name: 虫茧
skills.description: 自己回复20%生命，己方队伍获得1次奉献：获得10%吸血。
skills.descriptionEn: Self recovers 20% HP; your team gains 1 Dedication: gains 10% HP drain.

skills.name: 虫击
skills.description: 造成物伤，应对状态：本次技能威力变为2倍，无视敌方系别抵抗。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; counters status: this skill’s power becomes 2x and ignores the enemy’s type resistance.

skills.name: 等价交换
skills.description: 减伤90%，应对攻击：自己获得50%吸血。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 90%; counters attacks: self gains 50% HP drain.

skills.name: 重击
skills.description: 造成物伤，每次使用后，本技能能耗永久+1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; after each use, this skill’s energy cost permanently +1.

skills.name: 灾厄
skills.description: 对自己造成物伤，应对状态：改为对敌方造成物伤，且本次技能威力+120。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to self; counters status: instead deals physical damage to the enemy and this skill’s power +120.
